title: Cadmies Growth Roadmap
definition: A living document detailing the development and future plans of the CADMIES knowledge system.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A written guide that tracks the progress and plans of CADMIES, including the number of concepts, connections between them, and future projects.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A dynamic document that serves as a record of CADMIES' development, including its current metrics, domain taxonomy, and infrastructure status.
difficulty_levels.expert: A comprehensive, living document that captures the evolution of CADMIES, detailing its concepts, connections, metrics, domain taxonomy, infrastructure, and future projects, serving as a reference for developers and researchers.

extra_fields.insight: The roadmap provides a clear overview of CADMIES' growth and future direction.
